set.t: Probably dug up by the gang; D until an outcome is found (spring 1903 trial at Mount Carroll). A Davenport paper put the express-car loot at $20,000-30,000 ('no accurate figures'), so the buried silver may have been only part of it; no account says the Iowa-bank silver was dug up. The Iowa bank here is largely Upper Mississippi River refuge land: look-only unless the land rules allow.

src: AP, Cedar Rapids Gazette, 9 Jan 1903, p. 2
